reveal.spread.note: Share of each beat's narration over which its parts appear

reveal.maxGap.note: Longest wait (s) between two parts appearing

reveal.duration.note: Seconds each part takes to slide/fade in

reveal.rise.note: Pixels each part rises as it appears

voice.pace.note: Voice speed baked into new reels (Deepgram speed); 1 = the voice's natural pace

pace.quick.note: Player 'Quick' rate on top of the baked pace

pace.gentle.note: Player 'Gentle' rate for hard or unfamiliar topics

beat.gap.note: Pause (s) after a beat's voice ends before the next beat

beat.lead.note: Delay (s) between a slide appearing and the voice starting (lets the slide fade in first)

music.level.note: Music bed volume when nobody is talking (0 = off)

duck.depth.note: How far the music dips under the voice (0.45 = slight duck, 1 = silence)

duck.threshold.note: Voice loudness (RMS) that gives the full dip; lower = ducks harder on quiet words

duck.attack.note: How fast (s) the music dips when she starts talking

duck.release.note: How slowly (s) the music swells back in the gaps; higher = less pumping

music.intro.note: Seconds of music alone before the first line

music.outro.note: Music fade-out (s) after the last line

beat.holdBase.note: Extra pause (s) on every finished slide before the next one

beat.holdPerText.note: More pause (s) for each text line on the slide, so busy slides linger

reveal.advance.note: Seconds each slide part appears EARLIER than an even spread would (the voice was leading the visuals)
